findings.source_quote: A quiet and restful spirit is an amazing quality. It is not humanly possible to achieve. When you see this spirit in someone, you can know it comes from a heart of brokenness. According to Isaiah, it is a choice: …In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not –Isaiah 30:15.
